description.p: Daftar is a native Rust desktop Markdown reader and knowledge studio. It renders Markdown with first-class right-to-left support for Persian and Arabic, Mermaid diagrams, syntax-highlighted code, footnotes and tables, and keeps a searchable library of highlights, bookmarks, flashcards and study roadmaps.
No JavaScript, WebView, Electron or Tauri: a single compiled binary.

ul.li: Persian/Arabic shaping, Unicode bidi and automatic direction detection
Mermaid subset rendering with pan, zoom and PNG export
PDF and PNG export with embedded fonts
Portable mode: run from a USB drive

description.p: Fixes the Windows packaging step of the release workflow and adds the document reading-width control, the RTL application layout and per-document reading width overrides.
First public release: native Markdown reader with RTL support, diagrams, knowledge library, exports, English/Persian UI and portable mode.
